entries.title: Sign-ins on your other computers say where they are in your language
entries.body: In a language other than English, the words that name where a sign-in or connection lives, such as on another computer or as another user on this one, now read in your language. That covers sign-ins and custom APIs in Settings, where each project runs, connections to GitHub and other hosts, the card about saved resets, Activity lines and the phone's settings.
entries.noPicture: Every view keeps its layout and English stays word for word the same; only the words change in the other languages.
